prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: original A for a one-difference mobile comparison puzzle.
Primary request: one landscape 4:3 image. A mature flat gouache fashion editorial illustration viewed directly from above, muted plum, sea green, coral and ink navy, textured lilac background. A folded cream cardigan occupies center with FIVE ROUND dark navy buttons down its center-front placket, evenly spaced and fully visible. Around it: a coral scarf folded at upper left, two tan gloves at lower left, navy belt coiled upper right, three thread spools lower right, metal scissors at lower center, two sewing needles on a small felt cushion at far right, a wooden comb lower left and a folded handkerchief. No people. Each button about 6% image width, cardigan not cropped. Rich tactile painted materials and clear outlines for mobile comparison.
No comparison panels, writing, people, captions, digits, labels, logos, border, watermark, highlight or UI. Do not make the future difference yet.

review.displayedEffect: Side-by-side unfiltered originals; reveal circle only
